title: Katie Zacharia, Trump’s New Press Secretary, Is Fired After 5 Days
partialText: The ouster came as Ms. Zacharia was shadowed by questions about how she had presented her legal career and handled her first press briefing.

title: U.S. Budget Deficit Nears $2 Trillion, a Reality Check for Trump’s Cost Cutting
partialText: Higher interest rates are inflating borrowing costs as the Trump administration spends on the Iran war and tariff refunds.

title: What Measures Keep Students Safe? Prevention, Not Defenses, Experts Say
partialText: The gunman who killed four in Bend, Ore., entered an elementary school by shooting through a locked door, raising questions about what more schools can do to protect children.

title: Russia Appears to Step Up Efforts to Influence U.S. Voters
partialText: One campaign has created social media posts focusing on U.S. support for Israel to sow discord ahead of the midterm elections.

title: $137 Million in A.I.-Generated Ads Flood the Midterms
partialText: Republicans have used A.I.-generated content more often than Democrats, ranging from subtle enhancements to convincing deepfakes.

title: A Guide to Nathan Fielder’s Work Before Watching ‘You Can See Everything’
partialText: The comedian may be an unexpected choice for a documentary about the disgraced Theranos founder, but his TV shows suggest why he’s a good fit.

title: ‘You Can See Everything’ Review: The Slippery Mind of Elizabeth Holmes
partialText: The disgraced tech entrepreneur and the comic Nathan Fielder chat and joust in a dizzying movie about truth, reality and the contours of knowledge.

title: Israeli Settlers Attack Palestinians and Washington Post Journalist in West Bank
partialText: In the latest surge of violence, settlers targeted Palestinians during the olive harvest, a cultural touchstone and economic lifeline in the Israeli-occupied area.

title: The Rupturing Trump-Zelensky Relationship Stands to Hurt Ukraine and Its European Allies
partialText: Where the two presidents’ war of words will end is anybody’s guess. But if it continues, it could threaten the crucial operational help that Ukraine still gets from the United States.

title: What Life Is Like in Kyiv as Russia Tries to Make It Unlivable
partialText: A day in the Ukrainian capital, a new kind of battlefield far from the front, where daily life means assessing — and accepting — deadly risks.

title: Pope Asks Putin for a Cease-Fire for a Ukrainian City Under Siege
partialText: Recovering from lung cancer surgery, Pope Leo XIV spoke with Vladimir V. Putin to make a plea for Oleshky, where mines and drones have trapped some 2,000 people who are at risk of starvation.

title: A Bitter White House Feud, Even by Trump-Era Standards: Alina Mildon and Richard Grenell
partialText: Two Trump allies — Alina Habba Mildon and Richard Grenell — are locked in a raging dispute that has its roots in the battle for a share of the spoils in Venezuela.

title: More Trump Allies Aided Pro-Russian Balkan Government
partialText: The daughter of the president’s chief of staff joined an American businessman in Republika Srpska as he explored a gas pipeline. And six current and former campaign advisers recently traveled there for an election.

title: Terry Tao Is on the Front Lines of the Debate Over AI and the Future of Math
partialText: The Fields Medalist and celebrated mathematician is on the front lines of a debate about artificial intelligence and the future of his field.

title: Young Voters Say They Are Turning Their Backs on Trump and His Party
partialText: One of the biggest surprises of 2024 was the swing of young voters, particularly men, away from Democrats to Donald Trump. Now they are swinging back.

title: Is Anyone Actually in Charge of the Democratic Party? And Does It Matter?
partialText: This year’s midterm elections are a test of whether a party can be a success and a failure at the same time.

title: Caracas Is Eerily Safe After Deadly Police Raids in Venezuela Killed Thousands
partialText: Crime plunged after police raids killed thousands. Venezuela is now withdrawing from the International Criminal Court as it investigates this blood-soaked campaign.

title: Trump’s Attempt to Deport Ilhan Omar Is Another Leap Toward the Abyss
partialText: This is more than just another persecution of one of the president’s political enemies.

title: This Texas Region Flipped for Trump. Will It Stay Red?
partialText: With control of the Senate at stake, Mara Gay traveled to this Texas border region to hear from voters.

title: Japan’s Leader Says She Loses Hours to Makeup and Chores. Opinions Abound.
partialText: Sanae Takaichi said she has a busier schedule than her male predecessors, a nod to the disproportionate share of household tasks in Japan that fall to women.
